name: Critical Effects (BC): Explosive - Arm
description: Black Crusade, Table 7-11 (p. 250). Look up the total Critical Damage. Mechanical effects only - read the full description from the rulebook.

results.text: The target drops anything held in that hand. Challenging (+0) Toughness Test or Stunned for 1 round.
[[1d10]] Weapon Skill Damage and [[1d10]] Ballistic Skill Damage. Anything carried in the hand is destroyed; if it was an explosive it goes off - use result 9 instead.
Stunned for 1 round. Limb useless until medical attention. Challenging (+0) Toughness Test or suffer Blood Loss.
Ordinary (+10) Toughness Test or lose the hand. On a success, 1 permanent Weapon Skill Damage and 1 permanent Ballistic Skill Damage.
[[1d5]] levels of Fatigue and Blood Loss. Arm broken: counts as having one arm until repaired.
Arm lost. Immediate Challenging (+0) Toughness Test or die from shock. On a success: Stunned for [[1d10]] rounds, [[1d10]] levels of Fatigue and Blood Loss.
The target dies. If he held a weapon with a power source, it explodes for [[1d10+5]] Impact Damage to anyone within 2 metres.
As result 9. In addition, carried ammunition explodes for [[1d10+5]] Impact Damage to anyone within [[1d10]] metres, and any carried grenades or missiles detonate on his person.
